documentation.content:
A Cloud Scheduler job logged a failed attempt (severity>=ERROR on resource.type=cloud_scheduler_job). Common causes: 401 UNAUTHENTICATED (the job header holds a stale X-Scheduler-Secret, e.g. after a rotation), 504 DEADLINE_EXCEEDED (attempt deadline below the endpoint's runtime), 5xx from the endpoint.

Check: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_scheduler_job" AND severity>=ERROR' --project=daneshire --freshness=1d --format="value(timestamp,resource.labels.job_id,jsonPayload.status,httpRequest.status)"`

See scripts/ops/README.md.

conditions.displayName: Scheduler attempt finished with an error
